back: Used for activities currently in progress (e.g., 'I am writing this blog').

Describes an activity in progress before another past point (e.g., 'He had been suffering from stress').
Verbs like 'know' or 'seem' usually take simple forms (e.g., 'it seems a wonderful place').
Used for annoying habits (e.g., 'they are constantly complaining').
